extracted.name: Stuffed Celery
extracted.description: Stuffed celery is easy to make and kids love it. My great grandma always made this and my cousins and I used to fight over the last piece.
ingredient_lines: 1 bunch celery, cut into bite-size pieces
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, mix together the cream cheese and sour cream. Stir in the walnuts and chopped olives.
Spread filling onto the celery pieces.
